en.title: Maximum Bitwise OR After Doubling at Most K Times
en.description:
Each operation picks one array element and multiplies it by 2, at most K times in total; maximize the bitwise OR of all elements. The resource-migration text at the start of the source has nothing to do with its explicit function and examples, so this site implements only the doubling rule.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, solution, and tests.
en.input: This site's ranges: the first line contains n K (1≤n≤100000, 0≤K≤30), and the second line contains n non-negative integers (0..10⁹).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation:
Example 1: doubling 9 gives 12 OR 18=30, which beats the 25 obtained by doubling 12.

Example 2: no operation is allowed, so the answer is 1 OR 2=3.

Example 3: doubling zero still gives zero, so the answer is 0.
hints: Put all the doublings on a single element; prefix and suffix ORs give the OR of the remaining elements for each candidate in constant time.
